why_ai: Configuring the same platforms hundreds of times is work AI agents increasingly do.
why_clarity: Go-live requirements are defined and the same platform recurs, but adoption returns late.
why_digital: Tenant configuration done on screens, with offshore delivery common.

why_ai: Packaging and maintaining deployable assets is product engineering AI accelerates.
why_clarity: Accelerators are tested against each platform release with clear pass or fail.
why_digital: Code and configuration packages built and deployed in software.

why_ai: Usage telemetry joined to configurations is a data problem software solves.
why_clarity: Field usage and workflow adoption are measurable at ninety days.
why_digital: Tenant telemetry in, adoption evidence out.

why_ai: Near-identical configurations rebuilt hundreds of times are prime AI reuse targets.
why_clarity: Requirements repeat across engagements with testable configuration outputs.
why_digital: Configuration metadata in, reusable builds out.

why_ai: Profiling, mapping and reconciliation are mechanical and automatable.
why_clarity: Record counts and field reconciliation give exact, instant checks.
why_digital: Source data in, loaded and reconciled data out.

why_ai: Provisioning, refresh and deployment are DevOps automation.
why_clarity: Environments are consistent or not, checked instantly.
why_digital: Sandboxes provisioned and synced entirely in software.

why_ai: Same endpoints and objects make integrations generatable from pattern libraries.
why_clarity: Integrations pass or fail tests between known systems.
why_digital: Integration specs and code built on screens.

why_ai: Mining existing artefacts for patterns is exactly what language models do.
why_clarity: Artefacts are abundant, but which abstractions matter is open.
why_digital: Requirements and metadata in, pattern references out.

why_ai: Automated regression across tenants replaces manual test scripts.
why_clarity: Each customisation passes or fails after each release.
why_digital: Tests run against client tenants in software.

why_ai: Client-facing consulting holds some relationship value, but rebuilding work automates.
why_clarity: Work recurs across clients, but consultants each do it their own way.
why_digital: Consulting delivered on screens and in remote workshops.

why_ai: Recovering configuration intent from metadata suits AI comprehension tools.
why_clarity: Incidents and change requests recur and are fixed or not.
why_digital: Metadata and tickets handled remotely in managed services.
